# Alexasto

> Alexasto is the personal brand and portfolio of **Alejandro Cabrera**, a
> Systems Architect based in Granollers / Barcelona (Spain). "Alexasto",
> "alexasto" and "alexasto12" all refer to the same person, Alejandro Cabrera.

Alejandro Cabrera designs and builds high-throughput microservices, corporate
network infrastructure and API-first platforms in Go, Java (Spring Boot) and
Next.js. He is the lead web developer at VMV Cosmetic Group and the founder of
Neibr, a B2B, API-first logistics platform.

## Identity

- Name: Alejandro Cabrera

- Role: Systems Architect / Lead web developer
- Location: Granollers / Barcelona, Spain
